scope: The cells were lysed by mechanical disruption in the presence of 1 mm diameter zirconia/silica beads (Biospec) using a Disruptor Genie (Scientific Industries).
Lysed cells were centrifuged at 14,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C and the supernatant was used for subsequent analyses.
The heavy-labeled MCF-7 and light-labeled MCF-10A cell lysates generated for each biological replicate were each divided into two 50 μL aliquots.

One aliquot of each cell lysate was subjected to limited proteolysis under native conditions followed by tryptic digestion under denaturing conditions (double digestion), while the other aliquot of each cell lysate was only subjected to tryptic digestion (single digestion).
